1.consolidated_definition: Pértiga o vara larga de la gallera, convenientemente montada sobre los pies y en la que se posan los gallos de pelea.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Roosting pole or long staff of the gallera, conveniently mounted on feet and upon which fighting cocks are perched.
